environment.guest_settings: scrub inherited PS2_/GT4_PERF_ options; set GT4_PERF=1 PS2_SCALE=1 PS2_GS=gpu
environment.vulkan: preserve and record VK_ overrides in session result; other driver/overlay state not controlled
environment.gs_submission: GT4_GS_SYNC=0 default (asynchronous); GT4_GS_SYNC=1 restores the fully synchronous path (launcher records the value in the session result)
environment.pacing: GT4_PACING unset or paced (default): paced clock. GT4_PACING=audio: blocking WinMM clock as in slice152. GT4_PRESENT_MODE unset or fifo (default); mailbox and immediate are experiments and fail at swapchain creation when the surface lacks them. The launcher refuses other values and records both names in result.json (pacing_environment).

toolchain.build: CMake/Ninja VS2022 x64 ABI Windows SDK10.0.26100.0

classification: TASK-036 candidate: the slice191 GS stream build (same runtime capsule, port and shaders; new GS stream client: GS process SHA-256 pin, --config, WS_CLIPCHILDREN on attach, crash message) with the live PCSX2 GS process gt4-gs.exe (GPL fork moesuito/gt4recomp-gs, branch gt4gs/live) as the pinned GS process. GT4_RENDERER=pcsx2 in owner runs: the PCSX2 GS (Vulkan) renders into a child window of the game window; pacing, input, audio and F7/F8 stay in the game. GT4_RENDERER unset or donor (headless) keeps the donor renderer.
preserved_inputs: Same runtime capsule (slice191-gs-stream-runtime), port (slice191-gs-stream-port), shaders (slice153-pacing-shaders), EE library, VU1 and VU0 tables as slice191; only native/gs_stream and tools/gs_stream_record changed.
limits: READ_FIFO is answered by the PCSX2 GS (HWDownloadMode default); the night-race readback cost is TASK-037.
The GS child window is an MVP (TASK-038 hardens focus, fullscreen and hang behaviour).
Settings: only the minimal gt4-gs.ini (scale, blending High, deinterlace Automatic, aspect, vsync); TASK-039.
gt4-gs.exe still contains the PCSX2 recompilers and the software renderer JIT (TASK-042).
Save states are refused in pcsx2 mode.
